page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9h.xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server running on the KVM hypervisor. The instance is provisioned with 4 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs powered by a Hygon 7447v processor clocked at a base speed of 2.6 GHz. Memory capacity is configured at 8.0 GB of system RAM, yielding a ratio of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Hardware accelerators are absent, with zero GPUs present on the platform.

Storage configuration requires network-attached volumes, as the ecs.c9h.xlarge provides no local disk storage. Network connectivity features a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default. From a cost efficiency perspective, the 1:2 vCPU-to-memory allocation minimizes expense by omitting surplus memory capacity and unused integrated disks.

The hardware configuration is suited to compute-oriented operations that maintain modest memory footprints and require no hardware acceleration. Typical deployment fits include stateless web serving, microservices, build nodes in continuous integration environments, and general batch processing.
